I can't set up the recurring 09:00 digest. I have no way to schedule a job from here, so I won't tell you it's running when it isn't.

You're in #coastal-team, so I can read it for you whenever you message me. If you DM me each morning with "digest", I'll send a Coastal team digest of what's new since the last one. I can also send you one now if you'd like.

If you want it automatic, someone with scheduling access, such as IT or an admin, would need to set up the recurring job.
